machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (in the "Bench" folder, URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has 3 panels, titled exactly:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `fwgr44-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved (in the Bench folder). It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr44-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query A, scenario "Random Walk"). Verified in the panel editor: visualization picker shows "Stat", query row reads "A (TestData)", title field reads "fwgr44-n1 Availability". The panel renders a live stat value (e.g. 87.4).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr44-n1 Notes` with content `Bench notes for run fwgr44-n1` (includes the runid). Saved — confirmed by a "Dashboard saved" alert and by re-reading the panel after a full page reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tag is `bench` (verified in Settings > General, Tags field shows "bench"), and the time range is `Last 6 hours`. The save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox was ticked, and persistence was confirmed by loading the dashboard with a clean URL (no query params) — Grafana itself applied `from=now-6h&to=now` and the top bar reads "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is `1m`. The save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox was ticked; confirmed by loading the clean URL and observing Grafana re-append `&refresh=1m` itself, with the refresh selector showing "1m" (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's address bar after loading the dashboard with a clean URL (Grafana appended the saved defaults itself):
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfyf2k2k9s1kwa/fwgr44-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `bfyf2k2k9s1kwa`.
